parts.text: Code is not the hard part anymore. Knowing what to build is. FUDUGO combines AI-driven insight with 8+ years of engineering to build products that actually move business metrics. Most founders we work with have built something significant, but their product still doesn't show it yet.
That gap costs more than revenue. It costs the certainty that your product is finally being understood — and that the right people can feel it before they read another word.
